chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Sinani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Kufi al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Barmaki narrated to us. He said: 'Abdullah ibn Ahmad narrated to us. He said: Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman narrated to us from Thabit ibn Abi Safiyya, from Sa'id ibn 'Alaqa, from Abu Sa'id 'Aqisa, from the Master of Martyrs al-Husayn ibn 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all), from the Master of Deputies Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to me: O 'Ali! You are my brother, and I am your brother. I was chosen for prophethood, and you were selected for the Imamate. I am the patron of revelation, and you are the patron of interpretation. You and I are the two fathers of this Nation.

O 'Ali! You are my executor, my vicegerent (khalifa), my vizier, my inheritor, and the father of my descendants. Your partisans (shi'a) are my partisans, your supporters are my supporters, your friends are my friends, and your enemies are my enemies. O 'Ali! You will be my companion at the Pond (Hawd) tomorrow, and you are my companion at the Praiseworthy Station (Maqam al-Mahmud). You are my standard-bearer in the Hereafter, just as you are my standard-bearer in this world. Truly,

whoever befriends you will be made happy, and whoever is hostile to you will be made wretched. The angels draw near to Allah — glorified be His remembrance — through their love of you and their allegiance to you (wilaya). By Allah, those who love you in heaven are more numerous than those on earth. O 'Ali! You are the trustee of my Nation and the Proof of Allah (Hujjat Allah) over it after me. Your words are my words, your command is my command, obedience to you is obedience to me, your rebuke is my rebuke, your prohibition is my prohibition, and disobedience to you is disobedience to me. Your party is my party, and my party is the Party of Allah.
"Whoever takes Allah, His Messenger, and those who believe as their patron — indeed, the Party of Allah will prevail." [5:56]

key_terms.التَّأْوِيل: The Interpretation/Esoteric meaning — the inner explanation of revelation entrusted to the Imam
key_terms.التَّنْزِيل: The Revelation/Descent — the literal text of the Quran as revealed
key_terms.الْحَوْض: The Pond/Hawd — the pool from which the Prophet and his followers will drink on the Day of Resurrection
key_terms.الْحُجَّة: The Proof — the Imam as God's authoritative proof over humanity
key_terms.الْخَلِيفَة: The Vicegerent/Successor — the designated successor in governance and religious authority
key_terms.الْمَقَام الْمَحْمُود: The Praiseworthy Station — the station of intercession on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.الْمُجْتَبَى: The Selected One — epithet of Imam 'Ali, selected for the Imamate
key_terms.الْمُصْطَفَى: The Chosen One — epithet of the Prophet Muhammad, selected for prophethood
key_terms.الْوَصِيّ: The Executor/Legatee — one designated to carry out the Prophet's will
key_terms.حِزْبُ اللَّهِ: The Party of Allah — the believers who follow divine authority

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to Imam Ali about his position and Imamate?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad's (SAWW) address to Imam 'Ali (AS), declaring their fraternal bond and establishing 'Ali's divinely ordained role as the custodian of Imamate, interpretation of revelation, and leadership of the Muslim community. The Prophet enumerates the titles and prerogatives of 'Ali — executor, vicegerent, vizier, inheritor — and affirms that the community's alignment with 'Ali mirrors alignment with the Prophet himself. The hadith concludes by citing Quran 5:56, identifying the followers of 'Ali with the victorious Party of Allah, a statement that carries deep creedal significance for the Shia understanding of wilaya and authority.
